input.sql:
select *
from
    "Slack Actions"
where
      --     Check that the user has the relevant OKTA Group OR OKTA Application
      (Permissions IN (#{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_variable","line":"66725ea1","path":["okta_groups"]}')}) OR allowed_okta_apps IN (#{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_variable","line":"66725ea1","path":["okta_applications"]}')}))
      --     Check that the command is not null and that the user has it
      AND (
        (
			'#{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_recipe_function","line":"276b51f1","path":["parameters","command_name"]}')}' IS NULL
			OR '#{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_recipe_function","line":"276b51f1","path":["parameters","command_name"]}')}' = ''
		)
		OR Bot_command = '#{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_recipe_function","line":"276b51f1","path":["parameters","command_name"]}')}'
	)
